hero.text: Lingua was born from a simple idea: everyone deserves to learn a language, with no financial barrier and no boring method. AI finally lets us keep that promise.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.desc: Make language learning accessible to everyone, for free, thanks to the power of artificial intelligence.

philosophy.title: Our philosophy
philosophy.desc: Learning a language means opening yourself up to the world. Lingua is designed so every exchange is a real human experience, not a mechanical exercise.

technology.title: Our technology
technology.desc: We use the most advanced AI models to offer instant corrections, natural conversations and personalized tracking.

community.title: Our community
community.desc: Over 10,000 active learners around the world. A supportive community that progresses together, language after language.

story.heading: Our story
story.p1: Lingua was born in 2023 in Paris, in an apartment shared between two people passionate about languages and technology. Sophie and Lucas had both experienced the frustration of learning a language with apps that seemed built for robots.
story.p2: Their idea: what if AI could replace the private tutor? Not to imitate the human relationship, but to offer something unique — a conversation partner available 24/7, infinitely patient, able to adapt every response to the learner's exact level.
story.p3: A few months later, Lingua came to life. Today, more than 10,000 people use it every day to improve their English, Spanish, German, Arabic and many other languages.
